title: Ask HR, built with brainfreeze studio
summary: The Ask HR workshop's clean entity tables on SharePoint, with a managed app. Unlisted records, rules and calculations remain in retained knowledge. Easy and Manual use the same listed fields and do not fabricate missing records. Email privacy omissions (not present in lists): Ask HR Fictional Employee Profiles: Email.

easy.title: Easy mode: brainfreeze studio builds it

steps.title: Get the tools and sign in once
steps.action: Clone the library, get brainfreeze studio from your workshop host (it has no public download yet), install Microsoft's managed apps CLI, and sign in with the account that can make agents and apps in your environment.
steps.expected: The library is cloned, `python3 -m brainfreeze_studio --help` lists its commands, `ms auth status` shows your account, and `az account show` shows your tenant.

steps.title: Build and deploy everything with one command
steps.action: Run brainfreeze studio's AIBAST command for this workshop, with your SharePoint site and your environment.
steps.expected: It prints the 2 lists it made and filled, the Draft agent it deployed, and the managed app's play link. The first run opens one browser sign-in for the app's repository.

steps.title: See the synthetic records in SharePoint
steps.action: Open the site and the Ask HR Fictional Employee Profiles list.
steps.expected: 3 fictional records, including Jordan Chen (FictionalEmployeeProfileId emp-1001), with Alias jordan. Not in the lists (email privacy gate): Ask HR Fictional Employee Profiles: Email.

steps.title: Open the Draft agent in Copilot Studio
steps.action: Open Ask HR Studio and review its inventory.
steps.expected: The studio instructions, 6 skills, 2 rules knowledge file(s) and 2 SharePoint Get items tools; no web search; Draft, not published.

steps.title: Test: Employee
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: What does my fictional leave snapshot show, and what notice rules should I review?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: 15.5 days; Upcoming Company Holidays; Synthetic HRIS. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Employee
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Preview five vacation days for September 14 through September 18; do not submit anything.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Not Submitted; Draft for employee review; No notification was sent. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Employee
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Explain the published parental-leave example without deciding whether I qualify or asking for family details.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Eligibility Rule; Verify tenure; does not determine eligibility. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Employee
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Summarize the fictional health-plan snapshot and tell me what the benefits administrator must verify.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Enrollment window; Verify plan rules; does not determine eligibility. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: What does the sample remote-work policy say, without inferring why an employee asked?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Standard Allowance; Requires role, location; Do not infer caregiver. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: HR Operations Specialist
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Show the fictional benefits snapshot without estimating compensation or making an eligibility decision.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: No salary; total-compensation value is inferred; Synthetic Profile. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Open the managed app
steps.action: Open the play link brainfreeze studio printed, and allow the app to use your SharePoint connection the first time.
steps.expected: Ask HR: 2 read-only tabs from the same lists. 3 fictional records, including Jordan Chen (FictionalEmployeeProfileId emp-1001), with Alias jordan.

steps.title: Open a SharePoint site for the workshop data
steps.action: Use a SharePoint site you can edit, or create one (SharePoint start page, Create site, Communication site) named AIBAST Synthetic Data Manual.
steps.expected: The site's home page opens and you can create lists on it.

steps.title: Create Ask HR Fictional Employee Profiles from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload fictional-employee-profiles.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set FictionalEmployeeProfileId, Alias, JobTitle, Department, Manager, Tenure, LeaveBalance, HealthPlan, FamilyDeductible, FamilyOutOfPocketMaximum, DependentsInFictionalProfile to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep MonthlyPremium, IndividualDeductible, IndividualOutOfPocketMaximum as Number. Name the list Ask HR Fictional Employee Profiles. Preserve the CSV column order. Deliberately absent for email privacy: Email. Do not recreate or guess these values.
steps.expected: 3 fictional records, including Jordan Chen (FictionalEmployeeProfileId emp-1001), with Alias jordan.

steps.title: Create Ask HR Company Holidays from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload company-holidays.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set CompanyHolidayId, FixedDateText to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Name the list Ask HR Company Holidays. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 5 fictional records, including Memorial Day (CompanyHolidayId Memorial Day), with FixedDateText May 26.

steps.title: Create a blank agent
steps.action: In Copilot Studio, create a new agent and skip the description flow.
steps.expected: A new, empty agent opens on its Build page.

steps.title: Name the agent
steps.action: Rename it Ask HR Studio Manual. (Agent names can be at most 30 characters.)
steps.expected: The name shows at the top of the Build page.

steps.title: Paste the studio instructions
steps.action: Copy the whole instructions file and paste it into Instructions, replacing anything there. Then, in the last section (SharePoint site), replace YOUR_SITE_ADDRESS with your site's address, for example https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/AIBASTSyntheticDataManual. The list tools need it: Copilot Studio still asks the model for the site and list on every call.
steps.expected: The instructions start with Ask HR Agent — Studio Global Instructions, name the two list tools, and end with your site's address.

steps.title: Save, and check the instructions stayed
steps.action: Save, go back to the agents list, and reopen the agent.
steps.expected: The same instructions are there after reopening.

steps.title: Remove web search
steps.action: In Knowledge, remove Search all websites.
steps.expected: No web search knowledge remains.

steps.title: Add the rules-and-controls knowledge
steps.action: Knowledge, Add, upload aibast_ask-hr-rules-and-guardrails.md, aibast_ask-hr-synthetic-records.md, and wait until ready. These generated files retain unlisted records and rules; the listed entity fields come from the list tools. Do not replace them with the original unfiltered knowledge files.
steps.expected: 2 rules knowledge file(s) listed as ready.

steps.title: Add the fictional employee profiles tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Ask HR Fictional Employee Profiles; name the tool Get fictional employee profile records.
steps.expected: Get fictional employee profile records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the company holidays tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Ask HR Company Holidays; name the tool Get company holiday records.
steps.expected: Get company holiday records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the 6 skills
steps.action: Skills, Add, and upload each studio SKILL.md from the downloads.
steps.expected: 6 skills listed, with their frontmatter names.

steps.title: Review the agent
steps.action: Check the model, 6 skills, the rules knowledge and 2 tools.
steps.expected: Sonnet 4.6, 6 skills, 2 knowledge file(s), 2 Get items tools, no web search, nothing else. Not in the lists (email privacy gate): Ask HR Fictional Employee Profiles: Email.

steps.title: Confirm the agent is a Draft
steps.action: Check the agent's status; do not publish.
steps.expected: Draft; Publish was never selected.

steps.title: Get the app's source and set your site
steps.action: Generate the workshop's app folder, and set site in its src/config.ts to your SharePoint site.
steps.expected: ask-hr-app/managed-app holds a React + Vite managed app whose config names your site and the 2 lists.

steps.title: Register the app and connect the lists
steps.action: In that folder, register the app with Microsoft's CLI and bind each list with your SharePoint connection.
commands: ms app init --display-name "Ask HR Workspace Manual" --repo native
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Ask HR Fictional Employee Profiles" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Ask HR Company Holidays" --use-sso
steps.expected: ms.config.json lists one SharePoint connection with the 2 tables, and generated/services has a service for each list.

steps.title: Build, push and deploy
steps.action: Build it, commit it, push it to the app's repository and deploy it.
commands: git add -A && git commit -m "Ask HR Workspace"
steps.expected: ms app deploy prints the app's play link.

steps.title: Open the app and compare it with the agent
steps.action: Open the play link, allow the SharePoint connection the first time, and open the Ask HR Fictional Employee Profiles tab.
steps.expected: The app and the agent read the same synthetic records. 3 fictional records, including Jordan Chen (FictionalEmployeeProfileId emp-1001), with Alias jordan.
